limitations_and_boundaries: The study primarily uses murine models; human relevance requires further validation.
The role of other LOX family members (LOXL-1,3,4) was not extensively explored.
The exact molecular mechanism linking matrix stiffness to SRC activation is not fully elucidated.
The study focuses on breast cancer metastasis; applicability to other cancer types is not addressed.
The selected source chunks do not report a rescue, reconstitution, reversal, or epistasis experiment; that rung of the causal evidence chain remains untested within this extraction scope.
